objective: Make the Figma package release-coherent, omission-resistant, API-efficient, installable, and ready for local/live Figma use, while keeping Secure MCP Tunnel as an optional future pilot.
terminalTruth: Exact changed package bytes, validated Skills and plugin manifests, structured MCP request-response proof, fresh-install proof, live local Figma evidence, and truthful states for optional tunnel and pending behavioral proof.

obligations.sourceText: Audit the current project and close version, manifest, documentation, package, and evidence drift before claiming readiness.
Determine and implement the full-plugin Skill direction from discovery length through MCP dependencies without weakening capability depth.
Optimize API interaction and reduce the agent's ability to omit target, intent, retry identity, postconditions, and truthful result state.
Optimize IN, PROCESS, and OUT so every required user obligation remains traceable to an evidence-backed terminal state.
Package and fresh-install the exact candidate so registry/cache/runtime consumption is proven rather than inferred from source files.
Optional future pilot: connect the private stdio MCP through OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel and prove ChatGPT or Codex to live Figma end to end.
Prove on representative same-task cases that the candidate reduces omitted obligations and false completion without regressing capability quality.

nodes.label: Release and manifest truth
nodes.outcome: Package, Codex manifest, Claude manifest, README, doctor, and capability checks agree on candidate 0.6.0 and evidence boundaries.
nodes.entrypoint: package.json plus provider manifests and doctor/check-capabilities
proof: Version mismatch and missing-file negative tests
nonGoals: No live Figma, tunnel, hosted, UAT, or release PASS inferred from static gates
nodes.recovery: Reopen the exact mismatched producer/consumer rather than editing historical evidence into a false current state.

nodes.label: Skill discovery and dependencies
nodes.outcome: Sixteen capability descriptions are cheaper and discriminating, every Skill declares the bundled MCP, and conditional resources are reachable.
nonGoals: No unproved merge of sixteen first-class capability boundaries
nodes.recovery: Use frozen direct and near-miss cases before any future rename, merge, or split.

nodes.label: IN-PROCESS-OUT obligation ledger
nodes.outcome: A v2 work plan rejects missing required clauses, false PASS, invalid owners, multiple active packets, and evidence-free closure.
nonGoals: No planning ceremony for a one-step direct edit
nodes.recovery: Return the missing obligation or evidence reference to the active packet; never silently delete it.

nodes.label: Accountable structured MCP contract
nodes.outcome: Five tools advertise annotations/output schemas, return structured success/error envelopes, and reject mutation/export calls without trace, operation, and evidence obligations.
nonGoals: No automatic retry after ambiguous mutation timeout
nodes.recovery: Inspect structured retry ambiguity and Figma status before issuing a new mutation attempt.

nodes.label: Fresh package install
nodes.outcome: A fresh extracted package validates, installs through an isolated local marketplace, exposes five tools, and runs doctor from installed bytes.
nodes.entrypoint: npm pack plus isolated Codex marketplace/install/cache proof
nonGoals: No permanent duplicate source or conflicting installed plugin left behind
nodes.recovery: Remove only the isolated install/marketplace and rebuild from canonical source if package contents drift.

nodes.label: Behavioral omission comparison
nodes.outcome: Frozen same-task cases compare obligation closure, false PASS, trigger selection, recovery, tokens, calls, and latency against the baseline.
proof: Same model and tool access for frozen arms
nonGoals: No superiority claim from validators or author self-review
nodes.recovery: Preserve regression and inconclusive cases, then revise only the falsified discovery, method, contract, or evidence layer.

nodes.label: Optional Secure MCP Tunnel E2E
nodes.outcome: Deferred optional path: a workspace-authorized tunnel may later carry an accountable request through the exact packaged MCP and live Figma companion with readback evidence.
nodes.entrypoint: OpenAI Platform tunnel settings, tunnel-client, ChatGPT developer-mode connection, and live Figma
proof: Live read/write/readback/export with final queues zero
nodes.recovery: Reopen this optional packet only when OpenAI account authority, cost acceptance, tunnel RBAC, runtime key, workspace association, and a live companion are explicitly approved.
nonGoals: No public exposure of raw figma_exec
Out of scope for the current candidate; no API key or Platform tunnel setup is required
